# Dependencies

Make sure to download the latest version (as of July, 2018) of all dependencies below.

## OS dependencies
- python3
- llvm-dev
- texlive-full
- berkeley-abc

## Python 3 dependencies
- numpy
- numba
- matplotlib

# How to run

## Evolving
Call `$ darwin.py <input> -generations <gen> -verilog <output>` to evolve the `<input>`
through `<gen>` generations and save it as a verilog on the `<output>`.
Both files should use the ABC [1] verilog AIG format extended by the MAJ gates in the format below
(we added some examples into the folder `data/benchmarks`).

There are many other command line options available. Those are explained in details by
calling `$ darwin.py -help`.

### MAJ format

Majority gates are supported in the format `assign n1 = (i1 & i2) | (i1 & i3) | (i2 & i3);`,
where `n1 = MAJ(i1, i2, i3)`.

# Notes

The results shown in this capsule will not reflect the exact ones from the paper because it would take
a huge amount of time to evolve all of these benchmarks within $100\,000$ generations and 30 different random seeds.
Therefore, in this capsule, the default configuration runs the circuits for $30\,000$ generations and only 1 random seed,
which is enough to evaluate the tool and see that it works.

# References
[1] Brayton, R. and Mishchenko, A., 2010, July. ABC: An academic industrial-strength verification tool.
In _International Conference on Computer Aided Verification_ (pp. 24-40). Springer, Berlin, Heidelberg.

#!/usr/bin/env python3

import os
import sys
import glob
import argparse
import subprocess

import darwin

data_folder = "/data"
resu_folder = "/results"

argparser = argparse.ArgumentParser()

argparser.add_argument("-generations", default = "30000", help = "number of generations to run for each benchmark")
argparser.add_argument("-seeds", default = 1, type = int, help = "number of random seeds to run for each benchmark")
argparser.add_argument("-print-every", default = "5000", help = "print at every n generations")
argparser.add_argument("-no-plot", action = "store_false", dest = "plot", help = "disable ploting of data")
argparser.add_argument("-plot-format", default = "pdf", help = "plot format")
argparser.add_argument("-benchmarks", default = None, nargs = "+", help = "benchmarks' names")
argparser.add_argument("-mutation", help = "gene mutation rate by node")
argparser.add_argument("-lambda", dest = "popsize", help = "lambda value (children count)")
argparser.add_argument("-kappa", help = "number of cols in CGP matrix by nodes on seed circuit")
argparser.add_argument("-no-abc", action = "store_false", dest = "abc", help = "disable pre-processing through abc")
argparser.add_argument("-abc-commands", default = [ "choice", "compress" ], nargs = "*", help = "abc commands to use")

def main (argv):
    args = argparser.parse_args(argv)

    benchs = args.benchmarks or sorted(glob.iglob(
        os.path.join(data_folder, "benchmarks", "*.v")
    ))

    for fname in benchs:
        for seed in range(args.seeds):
            bench = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(fname))[0]
            print(bench, end = "")
    
            bpath = os.path.join(resu_folder, bench)
            
            if args.seeds > 1:
                print(", seed = ", seed, end = "")
                bpath = os.path.join(bpath, str(seed))
                
            print()
            os.makedirs(bpath, exist_ok = True)
    
            bfile = fname
    
            if args.abc:
                bfile = os.path.join(bpath, "abc.v")
    
                params = [
                    "abcrc", "read_verilog {}".format(fname),
                    *args.abc_commands,
                    "write_verilog {}".format(bfile)
                ]
    
                subprocess.run([ "berkeley-abc", "-q", ";".join(params) ])
                print()
    
            params = [
                bfile,
                "-generations", args.generations,
                "-seed", str(seed),
                "-print-every", "5000",
                "-print-on-change",
                "-verilog", os.path.join(bpath, "optimized.v"),
                "-save-curve", os.path.join(bpath, "curve.npz"),
                "-save-stats", os.path.join(bpath, "stats.npz"),
                "-save-best", os.path.join(bpath, "best.npz"),
                "-save-time", os.path.join(bpath, "time.npz"),
                "-save-energy", os.path.join(bpath, "energy.npz"),
                "-save-size", os.path.join(bpath, "size.npz"),
                "-raise-keyboard",
            ]
    
            if args.plot:
                fmt = args.plot_format.lstrip(".")
                plot_name = "plot.{}".format(fmt)
                params.extend([ "-plot", os.path.join(bpath, plot_name) ])
    
            if args.mutation is not None:
                params.extend([ "-mutation", args.mutation ])
    
            if args.popsize is not None:
                params.extend([ "-lambda", args.popsize ])
    
            if args.kappa is not None:
                params.extend([ "-kappa", args.kappa ])
    
            darwin.main(params)
            print()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[ 1 : ])

    if args.save_best is not None:

    if args.plot is not None:
        gp.plot(args.plot)

    if args.verilog is not None:

    if raised is not None:

            raise raised
